title: qp_input_was_limited can be set to false even when input is truncated
description: decode.rs line 88-91: qp_input_was_limited is computed as 'limit < body_bytes.len()'. When max_bytes * 4 == body_bytes.len() exactly, limit == body_bytes.len() so qp_input_was_limited=false even though the slice consumed the entire QP input. However the actual decoded output might be shorter than max_bytes (due to =XX sequences), meaning is_truncated will be false when it should be true. Repro: body = 'a' * n with all =XX encoding such that 4*max_bytes == encoded_len.
close_reason: Step 2 of decode catches over-decode: when decoded.len() > max_bytes, is_truncated=true. Edge case 4*n==len is handled correctly.
